names.description: Cloud names in full (not a Terraform variable; docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags").

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable). A DNS label. The service's name is given in full, so it does not go into it.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels on every object (not a Terraform variable).

tags.description: Cloud labels (not a Terraform variable): a Cloud Endpoints service has none; on the objects' Kubernetes labels only.

allow_alpha.description: Accept config-connector-extensions' v1alpha1 EndpointsService (not a Terraform variable).

grpc_config.description: The configuration for a gRPC endpoint. Either this or openapi_config must be specified.

iam.description: IAM bindings for topic in {ROLE => [MEMBERS]} format.

openapi_config.description: The configuration for an OpenAPI endopoint. Either this or grpc_config must be specified.

project_id.description: The project ID that the service belongs to.

service_name.description: The name of the service. Usually of the form '$apiname.endpoints.$projectid.cloud.goog'.

files_data.description: The contents of the files openapi_config and grpc_config name (not a Terraform variable).

deletion_policy.description: DELETE (default) or ABANDON (not a fabric variable).
